About Specialties Approach Fees FAQ {{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}}

Focused, Compassionate Therapy

Practical support for navigating change, anxiety, and relationships.
Evidence-informed, individually tailored.

I’m {{THERAPIST_NAME}}, a licensed therapist ({{LICENSE}}). I work with people who are ready to understand patterns, make durable changes, and build more satisfying lives.

{{PRIMARY_CTA_LABEL}} Contact

Sessions available in-person in {{CITY}}, {{STATE}} and via secure telehealth. Confidentiality and privacy are maintained; see footer for scope & crisis notes.

Common myths and what research shows

Myth: Therapy is just talking about the past.

Truth: While history matters, we focus on present patterns and practical strategies you can use now. We build skills and test changes between sessions.

Myth: You should wait until things are worse.

Truth: Early support often reduces suffering and prevents longer-term difficulties. Many people find short- to medium-term work helpful for transitions and stress.

Myth: One approach fits all.

Truth: I draw from evidence-based modalities ({{MODALITIES}}) and tailor what I use to your goals and values.

How I structure clinical work

Assessment & goals

We begin with a clear assessment of strengths, stressors, and goals so every session moves toward measurable progress.

Skills & experiments

Clinical tools are taught and practiced between sessions; we emphasize real-world experiments to test changes.

Integration & maintenance

Toward the end of work we consolidate gains and plan for relapse prevention and long-term resilience.

De-identified examples of typical work

Managing rising anxiety

Client presented with persistent worry affecting sleep and concentration. Through brief cognitive restructuring, behavioral activation, and paced exposure we reduced avoidance and improved daily functioning.

Transition after a major life change

After a career transition, a client reported a loss of direction. Using values clarification, behavioral experiments, and decision scaffolding they rebuilt a routine aligned with new goals.

Couples communication

Partners struggled with recurring conflict. Collaborative skills training and structured dialogues helped them communicate needs and renegotiate roles.

Note: examples are de-identified composites to illustrate typical clinical work rather than guarantees of outcome.

Questions people often ask

How do I know if therapy is right for me?

Therapy can help when concerns affect your ability to work, relate, or feel like yourself. A brief consult can clarify fit and expected focus.

What modalities do you use?

I use a combination of evidence-informed approaches ({{MODALITIES}}) tailored to the person and concern.

Do you take insurance?

Please check the Fees page for current policy. I provide superbills for out-of-network reimbursement in many plans.

See full FAQ

Ready to start?

Schedule a brief consultation to discuss goals, logistics, and fit. If we're not the right fit I can offer referrals.

Confidentiality: Information shared in sessions is protected except where disclosure is required by law (e.g., imminent risk of harm). This site is for informational purposes and does not replace an initial clinical assessment.

Crisis: If you or someone is in immediate danger, call local emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department. For urgent mental health support, contact your local crisis line.

.faq-grid{display:grid;gap:0.5rem} details summary{cursor:pointer;padding:0.6rem 0.8rem;background:var(--surface);border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(15,23,36,0.04)} .cta{padding:2rem 0} .cta-panel{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ffffff,#f5fbff);padding:1.2rem;border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem} .cta-panel h3{margin:0} .footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 200px 1fr;gap:1rem;padding:1.5rem 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(15,23,36,0.04)} .footer-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5rem} .small{font-size:0.86rem} .muted{color:var(--muted)} .emphasis{font-weight:600} @media(max-width:900px){ .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr} .myth-grid, .pillars-grid,
